adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` within `createAllCalendarEvents`, when iterating `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)`, the `else` branch for destinations *without* `destination.credentialId` calls `createEvent(c, event)` without passing `destination.externalId`. But `createEvent` was changed to accept an optional `externalId` and returns it on the `EventResult` (`{ externalId, credentialId: credential.id }`). Elsewhere in `EventManager`, booking/calendar reference fields were changed to use `externalCalendarId: result.externalId` (instead of `evt.destinationCalendar?.externalId`). Therefore, for destinations without a credentialId, `result.externalId` will be `undefined`, and the stored reference will lose `externalCalendarId` even if `destination.externalId` existed.
